method: regex scan of the synthesis for selection and ranking language, then classify each hit

the_four.frozen_statement: said the ordering improves without naming the axis; now says it orders combinations, not cells
the_four.decision_benefit_claim: the objective makes independent decision benefit a precondition for exploring RSI, and I had treated it as established; now qualified to the combination axis
the_four.reader_guidance_line: said the model has decision value without an axis; now limited to choosing combinations
the_four.checks_table: already recorded that top-k is dominated by about two combinations, which is itself a symptom of combination-only ranking, but it had never been read that way

the_third_one_matters_most.why: independent decision benefit is a stated precondition for the meta-learning and RSI work
the_third_one_matters_most.what_changes: the precondition is weaker than I had written, because the benefit lives on one axis
the_third_one_matters_most.what_does_not_change: RSI stays closed anyway, because cross-task transfer fails and that is a separate precondition

an_unexpected_finding: the top-k concentration recorded in C42/C69 was indirect evidence of this boundary all along; the boundary was never named, so nobody read it that way
verdict: H414 holds; four qualifiers added; a rescan leaves zero unqualified implications of cell-level ranking
limits: Only the synthesis was scanned; per-round reports and register history were left alone for traceability.
Whether a sentence implies cell-level ranking is a judgement call; the criterion used was whether a reader could conclude they can choose a cell line.
Retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim.
